Game Overview

Firewar is a adventure title where in Firewar, lead humanity's fight against rogue RoboSoldiers and their AI helicopters. Engage in intense battles using strategic card advantages and a diverse weapon arsenal. Experience thrilling story-driven missions and multiplayer mayhem, earning rewards to upgrade your prowess and arsenal for survival. Can you turn the tide?
